section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews the development and validation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) across cultural contexts, noting that while the BAS functions as a single dimension in Western samples, it shows a two-factor structure in non-Western samples (Malaysia, Brazil, Korea). The authors present their planned study examining the factor structure of the BAS among Indonesian women and men, with expectations of gender differences in body appreciation and a negative relationship between body appreciation and BMI.
